description: UK (England, Wales, Northern Ireland; Scotland has the same rate): statutory interest and the fixed sum on a late business-to-business or public-authority invoice (Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998). Rate = Bank of England base rate on the 30 June or 31 December before interest starts + 8% (11.75% for interest starting 1 July to 31 December 2026), fixed for the debt; interest = debt x rate / 365 x days; fixed sum £40 (debt under £1,000), £70 (under £10,000), £100 (£10,000 or more), plus reasonable recovery costs above that. With no agreed date, payment is due on the last of the 30 days beginning with the later of delivery and the invoice. Use this when someone in the UK asks how much interest they can charge a customer who paid late.
